Survey.title: Survey
Survey.description: Hotel guest satisfaction survey template and configuration owned by a hotel manager.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the hotel manager who owns this survey.

hotelName.description: Display name of the hotel property.

title.description: Title of the satisfaction survey shown to guests.

welcomeMessage.description: Short introductory message welcoming guests to share feedback.

thankYouMessage.description: Confirmation message shown after a guest submits their response.

coverTheme.description: Selected visual header banner theme for the guest survey.

status.description: Publication state controlling whether guests can access and submit the survey.

allowAnonymous.description: Whether guests can submit feedback completely anonymously without registration.

collectName.description: Whether to show an optional guest name field.

collectEmail.description: Whether to show an optional guest email field.

collectRoom.description: Whether to show an optional room number field.

collectStayType.description: Whether to show an optional stay type selector (leisure, business, family, couple).

autoAnalyze.description: Whether AI analysis runs automatically when viewing new responses.

questions.description: Ordered list of survey questions (1 to 25 items).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the survey was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the survey was last updated.

SurveyResponse.title: SurveyResponse
SurveyResponse.description: Online satisfaction response submitted by a hotel guest without mandatory registration.

surveyOwnerId.description: Owner UID copied from the parent survey for secure list queries.

isAnonymous.description: True if the guest chose not to provide identifying contact details.

guestName.description: Optional guest name (empty string when anonymous).

guestEmail.description: Optional guest email (empty string when anonymous).

roomNumber.description: Optional room number (empty string when omitted).

overallRating.description: Computed average 1-5 star score across rating questions (0 if none).

npsScore.description: Net Promoter Score value from 0 to 10 (-1 if survey has no NPS question).

answers.description: Map of questionId to answer value (number or string).

openComment.description: Consolidated free-text opinion provided by the guest for automatic AI analysis.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp when the guest submitted the survey.

OpinionAnalysis.title: OpinionAnalysis
OpinionAnalysis.description: Automated Gemini AI analysis snapshot summarizing guest opinions for a hotel survey.

surveyOwnerId.description: Owner UID of the hotel manager.

responseCount.description: Number of guest responses included in this analysis.

executiveSummary.description: Concise executive summary of guest satisfaction.

sentiment.description: Counts of positive, neutral, and negative responses.

strengths.description: Top highlighted strengths mentioned by guests.

improvements.description: Prioritized improvement areas by hotel department.

actionPlan.description: Concrete next steps recommended for hotel management.

themes.description: Recurring topics with sentiment and mention counts.

responseSentiments.description: Map of responseId to per-response sentiment classification and brief summary.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the analysis was stored.

/surveys/{surveyId}.description: Hotel satisfaction surveys managed by authenticated hotel staff and publicly readable by ID when active.

/surveys/{surveyId}/responses/{responseI.description: Guest responses submitted online (anonymously or with optional contact details); readable only by the survey owner.

/surveys/{surveyId}/analyses/{analysisId.description: Saved automated AI opinion analyses owned by the survey manager.
